portalsFound.observation: Listing of the MapServer: group layer 10 has 15 province sublayers (11-25: NTB, Jatim, DIY, Kalbar, Sulbar, Kaltara, Aceh, Sultra, Maluku, Kaltim, Jabar, Bali, Banten, Kepri, Jateng). None for Maluku Utara, Papua Barat, Papua Barat Daya, Papua, Papua Selatan, Papua Tengah, Papua Pegunungan. Layers 28-35 and 51-57 are oil-palm permits in Papua districts, not parcels.
